## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text is [菩提流志](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E5%BF%97) Bodhiruci II's Tang version of the *Sumati-paripṛcchā*, the third parallel translation alongside [Zhú Fǎhù's T0334](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0026) and [Kumārajīva's T0335](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0027). The work was incorporated as one of the constituent assemblies of the larger *[Mahā-ratnakūṭa](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0001)* (T0310).

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [菩提流志](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E5%BF%97) Bodhiruci II's Cháng'ān period (706 – 713 CE), the years of his great *Bǎo jī* compilation project.

The Taishō text (T0336) is established on the standard apparatus.
